name: happy-tirana-courier
description: Local monorepo for Happy Tirana Courier: admin, business, rider, API, and PostGIS database schema.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:admin & npm run dev:business & npm run dev:rider & wait
scripts.clean:next: rm -rf apps/admin-portal/.next apps/business-portal/.next apps/rider-app/.next apps/admin-portal/.next.stale-* apps/business-portal/.next.stale-* apps/rider-app/.next.stale-*
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U happy -d happy_tirana -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001_initial_postgis.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/002_customer_ordering.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/003_customer_accounts_cart_seed.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/004_customer_catalog_addresses_routes.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/005_guest_carts.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/006_rider_dashboard_seed.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/007_admin_business_categories.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/008_admin_auth_seed.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/009_business_auth_seed.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/010_hide_sample_catalog.sql
